1306-4659-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1306-4659-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mana Crypt, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

339-677-4359-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-4359-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

240-955-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

443-4279-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4279-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1879-2023-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3110-4050-8077-8107.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
"Raffine's Guidance" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
3110-4050-8077-8107.description:

Sigil of the Empty Throne triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Raffine's Guidance, attaching it to another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Raffine's Guidance attached, adding {W}.

339-677-7175-8095.description:

When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

6247-6249-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6247-6249-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-5870-6798.description:

Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

799-3582-5902.easyPrerequisites: Kaya must be able to survive one turn cycle, or you control an additional legendary creature or planeswalker.
799-3582-5902.description:
Cast Kaya the Inexorable by paying {3}{W}{B}, causing her to enter with ten loyalty counters due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Kaya's last ability by removing seven loyalty counters, getting her emblem.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, the emblem triggers, allowing you to cast Karn's Temporal Sundering from hand, graveyard, or exile without paying its mana cost, gaining an extra turn after this one.
Repeat step 3 each turn.

539-2034-5003-7892.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.

3670-4166-5078-5705.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Ingenious Artillerist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability trigger. dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and exiling the top card of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

622-2557-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.

Gain life.

Repeat from step 2.

An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4094-4875-5703.description:

Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

Resolve Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability.

When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand from your graveyard.

Aphetto Vulture dies, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Aphetto Vulture from the top of your library by paying {0}.

Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
Warchanter Skald has at least one Aura and/or Equipment attached.
529-1636-3590.description:

Resolve the Warchanter Skald ability from step 1, causing you to surveil.

Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
